name: themate-dev-tests
description: Dev-only tooling for the Themate theme. Deliberately NOT at the app root: Frappe's esbuild runs `yarn build` in any app whose package.json defines a build script (frappe/esbuild/esbuild.js:447), and a package.json at the app root also invites `yarn install` to pull these dev dependencies onto a production bench. The Frappe app itself has no npm dependencies.

scripts.test: npm run test:flags && npm run test:linked-fields && npm run test:arabic-pdf && npm run test:palette && npm run test:build && npm run test:css && npm run test:js && npm run test:icons && npm run test:form-tabs && npm run test:grid-text && npm run test:list-row && npm run test:page-head && npm run test:workspace-cards && npm run test:sidebar-art && npm run test:loading && npm run test:calendar && npm run test:flicker && npm run test:linked-filters && npm run test:list-pager && npm run test:form-panel && npm run test:print && npm run test:search && npm run test:workspace-race && npm run test:integration
